content: How do you tighten it?  Once it bottoms on the nylox it spins in the tool.
The  tool  aligns  everything  perfectly,  it's  extremely precise. But really hard to  get  into place
Honestly, this is the most ridiculous way to tighten a nut in such a confined space. The helper is not helping, and it should be bright orange so you can see it even in the dark corners.

replies.content: Orange instead of black would have been better, but if you manually raise the bed, you hand will fit, and if you hook the edge of the tool it works perfectly even  if you can't see it.
